summary: Validated client-side PDF import (pdfjs-dist) in Contexte panel. Uploaded /app/test_cv.pdf via data-testid 'pdf-input' after closing settings modal and opening context via 'open-context-btn'. CV textarea (data-testid 'ctx-cv') was auto-filled with extracted text containing 'Jean Dupont', 'Superviseur', 'Intelcom', 'Pratt & Whitney'. No pdfjs worker errors in console. Extraction happened 100% client-side (no backend fallback needed).

issues: Console React warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' (repeated 4x). Not blocking PDF import but should be fixed by main agent.

action_items: Fix React duplicate-key warning appearing on initial load (unrelated to PDF import).
critical_code_review_comments: PDF import successful client-side via pdfjs-dist worker at /pdf.worker.min.js — no upload dependency, resolves Android upload proxy issue.
Success toast 'CV importé depuis le PDF' was not detected at check time (likely auto-dismissed before check at 5s). Field population confirms success; toast timing is minor.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Client-side PDF extraction confirmed working via Playwright set_input_files with /app/test_cv.pdf. Keywords Jean Dupont/Superviseur/Intelcom all found in ctx-cv textarea. Real Android testing not possible in this env but client-side path is validated end-to-end.
rca of the issue: Original bug: Android upload of multipart PDF to backend proxy failing/truncated. Fix (already applied): extract PDF text client-side using pdfjs-dist with worker served at /pdf.worker.min.js, server fallback only if client extraction fails. Verified working.
